description: This file defines the SharedBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which facilitates inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore-based synchronization. It includes class definitions, constructors, methods for locking/unlocking, and accessors for shared buffer management.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for sharing data over process boundaries using shared memory and semaphores, supporting producer-consumer synchronization.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A nested class managing semaphore locking and unlocking, abstracting platform-specific semaphore handling.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the shared buffer as a consumer.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the shared buffer as a producer with specified mode, size, and administration area.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests permission to produce data, locking the producer semaphore.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete and unlocks the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests permission to consume data, locking the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed and unlocks the producer semaphore.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Sets or gets user permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Sets or gets group permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Sets or gets permission modes for the shared buffer.
